_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: A contour print that reads as texture from more than a few feet away, on the collar and three-button placket most golfers already default to. Four-way stretch so it moves at the top of the backswing, and UPF 50+ so an afternoon round costs you nothing.
pieceHeadline: Up close it's a map. From across the fairway it's texture.
pieceParas: The contour print is the point. Near to, it reads as a topographic line drawing; at conversational distance it reads as texture. That is the right way round for something worn for five hours next to people who are looking at you.
It is the most-reached-for print in the range for exactly that reason — it carries a pattern without ever becoming the thing anyone comments on.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, mid-round. Golfer at the top of the backswing or walking off a tee, shot from slightly below so the collar and shoulder line read. The print has to be legible as texture at this distance. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
